study: Tuesday CICFlowMeter CSV forward-vs-bidirectional FP32 MLP v1
supersedes: New CSV-only experiment; does not alter or complete the previous PCAP/kernel feasibility study
direction: Original CSV forward/backward orientation; no SYN or monitored-server equivalence asserted

units.lengths: CICFlowMeter packet-length columns, payload-byte convention; not kernel TCP segment length

bidirectional: min of observed-direction length minima; measured zero retained
sum of forward and backward packet counts
cleaning: Only TCP protocol 6. Reject empty/unknown labels, missing identity, invalid IPv4/ports/timestamp date; preserve raw labels.
All selected forward/backward numeric fields, counts and duration: finite nonnegative integral int64. Forward count >=1; forward and observed backward minima <= maxima; payload lengths <=65535.
For each observed direction, header total must lie between 20*count and 60*count. Directional max IAT <= flow duration; count<2 implies zero max IAT.
Ignore all backward feature contributions when backward count=0; record nonzero unused fields as diagnostics. Do not impute a missing minimum as zero.
Duplicate Fwd Header Length columns must agree. Exact duplicate complete CSV records: keep first physical source row. Do not deduplicate by features/label.
Reject aggregate int64 overflow or values above 2^53-1 (exact float64 input range). No clipping or imputation.
Profile missing/nonfinite/negative values in every column, but exclude only for required model/identity fields. Unused rate-column NaN/Infinity is not an inference input.
grouping_attempts_in_order: Union exact forward vectors, exact bidirectional vectors, canonical TCP 5-tuples (all reuse), and unordered endpoint-IP-pair + raw date/minute timestamp groups
If first scheme cannot achieve each target within 5 percentage points with each source category represented, omit endpoint/minute unions; retain exact vectors and canonical tuples
If second scheme remains infeasible, exact forward/bidirectional vector union groups only; report loss of session separation
split: Fixed-seed size-descending group allocation minimizing class/category and row-count target imbalance; tie hashes depend only on seed and member source lines. Target 70/15/15. Never split a union component. Category stratification is support control, not a predictor. Choose first feasible grouping without predictions.
split_limitations: Not campaign-independent: Tuesday has two attack campaigns. Coarse minute clock lacks AM/PM; endpoint/minute grouping is a conservative proxy, not validated independent sessions. Repeated source flows, campaign correlations and attack-specific service ports can remain.
preprocessing: Separate StandardScaler per representation; fit training IDs only; float64 scaler then float32 normalized network input; reject nonfinite outputs
initialization: Authors src/mlp.py Net(6,2), fresh torch seed reset identically for each model; no old checkpoint loaded
checkpoint: Lowest validation cross-entropy, earliest exact tie; full 32 epochs for each model
decision: Ordinary FP32 argmax; exact logit tie selects class 0
test_access: Only after both checkpoints/scalers frozen; no tuning or resampling by predictions
baselines: Majority class from training labels; training-only empirical majority class per destination port, unseen-port fallback to training majority
pr_metrics: Average precision (step PR-AUC) and trapezoidal precision-recall area, scored by logit1-logit0; distinguish the two
uncertainty: 2000 paired percentile bootstrap draws of frozen test union-components, seed=20261110; aggregate confusion counts per component. Conditional on these imperfect proxy groups and fixed fitted models, not a campaign-level or training-seed confidence interval.
kernel: No quantization, BPF modification/execution, packet reconstruction, network attachment or production model replacement
